name: Toto
source:
"I'm cute enough, aren't I?"

Hakushin's subordinate. He rescued her when she was about to be killed by a bird demon. She's always floating, jumping, and restless.

She treats her companion, Bakugo, like he is a pet because he is "ugly." She directs her murderous intent towards those she thinks are cuter than herself.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_toto.png]official website[/url]]
